# PixiJS 8.20.1

Exact unmodified browser distribution copied from the project's installed `tools/presentation_lab/node_modules/pixi.js/dist/pixi.min.js`.

The bundled MIT license was read on 2026-09-13 and is retained alongside the runtime. This is a runtime dependency, not an uploaded CI artifact. Canonical play loads it lazily only when the high-resolution replacement actor is needed. No model/runtime installation or external download was performed.
